+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, Security
+from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
+from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
+import json
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+oauth2_scheme_read = OAuth2PasswordBearer(
+    tokenUrl="token", 
+    scopes={"read": "Read access"}, 
+    scheme_name="my_oauth2_scheme"
+)
+oauth2_scheme_write = OAuth2PasswordBearer(
+    tokenUrl="token", 
+    scopes={"write": "Write access"}, 
+    scheme_name="my_oauth2_scheme"
+)
+
+@app.get("/read")
+async def read(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme_read, scopes=["read"])):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+@app.get("/write")
+async def write(token: str = Security(oauth2_scheme_write, scopes=["write"])):
+    return {"token": token}
+
+openapi_schema = get_openapi(
+    title="Test App", 
+    version="1.0.0", 
+    routes=app.routes
+)
+security_schemes = openapi_schema.get("components", {}).get("securitySchemes", {})
+my_scheme = security_schemes.get("my_oauth2_scheme", {})
+scopes = my_scheme.get("flows", {}).get("password", {}).get("scopes", {})
+
+print(f"Scopes: {json.dumps(scopes)}")
+assert "read" in scopes
+assert "write" in scopes
